elements.content: As a football fan, I want to see a list of upcoming football matches so that I can decide which matches to follow.
As a football fan, I want to mark a match as interesting so that I can easily track it later.
The system shall provide functionality to manage football match data including storage, retrieval via API, real-time updates, and archiving.
The system shall allow authenticated users to follow/unfollow matches and persist these relationships across sessions.
The system shall enable users to filter matches by league, date range, and search by team name.
Match list loads in under 2 seconds for 95% of requests (with cached data).
Match: Attributes include matchId, homeTeam, awayTeam, dateTime, venue, league, status, homeScore, awayScore.
User: Attributes include userId, username, email.
UserFollow: Join entity linking userId to matchId with a timestamp.
Assume access to a reliable football match data API for schedules, scores, and team info.
Social features, predictive analytics, and push notifications are out of scope for MVP.
